items.en: Added `--hold-idle-file` and `--max-hold-min` to `self-hosted-runner`, to keep an idle session while your host reports processes it left running
items.zh: 为 `self-hosted-runner` 新增 `--hold-idle-file` 和 `--max-hold-min`，以便在主机报告其遗留运行的进程时保持空闲 session

items.en: Added a tip for the Explanatory output style, shown when you ask Claude for explanations
items.zh: 新增 Explanatory 输出样式的提示，在你要求 Claude 解释时显示

items.en: \[VSCode] Added syntax coloring to code blocks in Claude's replies, in light, dark and high contrast dark themes
items.zh: \[VSCode] 为 Claude 回复中的代码块新增语法着色，支持浅色、深色和高对比度深色主题

items.en: \[VSCode] Added a "Running UserPromptSubmit hooks" spinner status and screen reader announcement for slow UserPromptSubmit hooks
items.zh: \[VSCode] 新增“Running UserPromptSubmit hooks”加载状态和屏幕阅读器播报，用于响应缓慢的 UserPromptSubmit hooks

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Added a Skills view to Claude Tag analytics showing how often Claude runs each attached skill in Slack channels and which go unused, with Usage links in admin settings
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 在 Claude Tag 分析中新增 Skills 视图，显示 Claude 在 Slack 频道中运行每个已附加 skill 的频率以及哪些未被使用，并在管理设置中提供 Usage 链接

items.en: Changed `ultrathink` in the interactive terminal to run its turn at xhigh effort on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable 5.1 through Anthropic's API; typed while Claude is working, it raises the rest of that turn
items.zh: 变更交互式终端中的 `ultrathink`，使其在 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 上通过 Anthropic 的 API 以 xhigh 力度运行该轮；在 Claude 工作时输入，会提升该轮剩余部分的力度

items.en: Changed the `ultrathink` rainbow to appear only where the keyword can raise effort, and not when the word is quoted or part of a file path
items.zh: 变更 `ultrathink` 彩虹效果，仅在关键词能提升力度时显示，且当该词被引用或属于文件路径的一部分时不显示

items.en: Changed Ctrl+D in agent view to match the prompt: on an empty input, pressing it twice exits
items.zh: 变更 agent 视图中的 Ctrl+D 以与 prompt 一致：在空输入时，按两次退出

items.en: Changed `--output-format json` and `stream-json` output to write DEL, C1 control and Unicode format characters inside strings as `\uXXXX` escapes; parsed values are unchanged
items.zh: 变更 `--output-format json` 和 `stream-json` 输出，将字符串内的 DEL、C1 控制字符和 Unicode 格式字符写为 `\uXXXX` 转义；解析后的值不变

items.en: Changed model names and IDs to drop the `[1m]` suffix and its label on models where the suffix has no effect; the suffix is still accepted
items.zh: 变更模型名称和 ID，在 `[1m]` 后缀无效的模型上去掉该后缀及其标签；该后缀仍可接受

items.en: Changed startup warnings about permission rules in settings files to show once per user until the rule changes
items.zh: 变更关于设置文件中权限规则的启动警告，改为每位用户显示一次，直到规则变更

items.en: Changed `/code-review` to tell Claude to put the effort level first and use max only when asked
items.zh: 变更 `/code-review`，让 Claude 优先设置力度级别，仅在要求时使用 max

items.en: Changed `DISABLE_COMPACT` in settings files and in a mod's `$.env.set` so they can only turn compaction off, not back on
items.zh: 变更设置文件和 mod 的 `$.env.set` 中的 `DISABLE_COMPACT`，使其只能关闭上下文压缩，不能重新开启

items.en: Changed Claude Code on Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, and Foundry to load model settings from a signed file on downloads.claude.ai; set CLAUDE\_CODE\_MODEL\_CATALOG=off to turn this off
items.zh: 变更 Bedrock、Mantle、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的 Claude Code，改为从 downloads.claude.ai 上的签名文件加载模型设置；设置 CLAUDE\_CODE\_MODEL\_CATALOG=off 可关闭此功能

items.en: Changed sessions that set `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` with feature-flag fetching off to reuse a claude.ai skills list up to 10 minutes old that another session on the machine fetched
items.zh: 变更设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS` 且关闭功能标志获取的 session，改为复用本机其他 session 在 10 分钟内获取的 claude.ai skills 列表

items.en: Changed clicks on scrollbar arrows and bars in fullscreen lists to act when the mouse button is released, so moving off the scrollbar before letting go cancels the click
items.zh: 变更全屏列表中点击滚动条箭头和滚动条的行为，改为在释放鼠标按钮时生效，因此在松开前移出滚动条会取消点击

items.en: Changed `claude purge` to say it deletes data only on this computer, not anything stored by Anthropic
items.zh: 变更 `claude purge`，说明它仅删除本计算机上的数据，不删除 Anthropic 存储的任何内容

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed the extension to start Claude Code sessions with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` set while VS Code's telemetry setting is off, so they send no usage metrics or error reports and fetch no feature flags
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更扩展，在 VS Code 遥测设置关闭时以设置 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 的方式启动 Claude Code session，使其不发送用量指标或错误报告，也不获取功能标志

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed the session list side bar to load Web sessions when the Web tab is first opened, not at startup
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更 session 列表侧边栏，改为在首次打开 Web 标签页时加载 Web session，而非在启动时加载

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Changed Claude Tag admin settings to show a lock instead of # for private Slack channels that your own Slack account can see
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 变更 Claude Tag 管理设置，对于你自己的 Slack 账号可见的私有 Slack 频道，显示锁图标而非 #

items.en: Improved startup time for Pro and Max accounts by skipping two network requests on launches within an hour of the last check
items.zh: 改进 Pro 和 Max 账户的启动时间：距上次检查一小时内启动时跳过两个网络请求

items.en: Improved `/teleport` and `claude --teleport` to warn when a compacted cloud session loads from its last compaction, so the messages it summarized aren't in the local copy
items.zh: 改进 `/teleport` 和 `claude --teleport`：当已压缩的云端 session 从其最后一次上下文压缩处加载时给出警告，说明其摘要过的消息不在本地副本中

items.en: Improved the messages shown when a background session's process exits: they no longer promise a restart that isn't coming, and they say how to resume the session
items.zh: 改进后台 session 进程退出时显示的消息：不再承诺不会发生的重启，并说明如何恢复该 session

items.en: Improved artifacts with several views: Claude now routes each view on the link's `#name` and no longer says the address bar stays the same as you switch views
items.zh: 改进包含多个视图的 artifact：Claude 现在根据链接中的 `#name` 路由到对应视图，且不再声称切换视图时地址栏保持不变

items.en: Improved shell commands that reach their timeout: the result now shows the output so far and says the command is still running in the background
items.zh: 改进达到超时时间的 shell 命令：结果现在会显示目前已产生的输出，并说明该命令仍在后台运行

items.en: Improved compaction: when the model's reply has no summary in it, Claude Code now usually asks for the summary once more before it replaces the conversation
items.zh: 改进上下文压缩：当模型的回复中没有摘要时，Claude Code 现在通常会在替换对话前再请求一次摘要

items.en: Improved the Artifact tool's choice between a page and a document: explainers and visual or interactive work become artifact pages; documents are for writing people keep editing or pass around
items.zh: 改进 Artifact 工具在页面和文档之间的选择：讲解类以及视觉或交互类工作生成 artifact 页面；文档用于人们会持续编辑或传阅的写作内容

items.en: Improved startup time for launches whose only arguments are options and their values, such as `claude --model opus`
items.zh: 改进仅以选项及其值为参数启动时的启动时间，例如 `claude --model opus`

items.en: Improved the "Connection dropped" API error: it now says where to look first (the proxy or gateway in use, else VPN or firewall; Anthropic API only, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
items.zh: 改进“Connection dropped”API 错误：现在会说明应首先排查的位置（所用代理或网关，否则 VPN 或防火墙；仅适用于 Anthropic API，Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 不变）

items.en: Improved screen reader mode: deleting a rule in /permissions says "Deleted allow rule …" right away
items.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：在 /permissions 中删除规则时会立即提示“Deleted allow rule …”

items.en: Improved the message shown when a pasted sign-in code is refused: it now says the code may have expired or been used, and to sign in again
items.zh: 改进粘贴的登录验证码被拒绝时显示的消息：现在会说明验证码可能已过期或已被使用，并提示重新登录

items.en: Improved Slack connector sends: Claude now checks a channel's topic for posting rules before messaging a channel you didn't name
items.zh: 改进 Slack connector 发送：在向你未指定的频道发消息前，Claude 现在会检查该频道的主题以了解发帖规则

items.en: Improved screen reader mode: Claude's questions are listed as "Questions: Color (answered), Pages", without arrows or symbols
items.zh: 改进屏幕阅读器模式：Claude 的问题以“Questions: Color (answered), Pages”形式列出，不带箭头或符号

items.en: \[Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag routines that run in a new session: a run with nothing to report can now end without posting a throwaway message to the channel
items.zh: \[Claude Tag] 改进在新 session 中运行的 Claude Tag 例程：没有内容可报告的运行现在可以结束，而无需向频道发送一条无用的消息

items.en: \[Code Review] Improved Code Review's check run to say no further automatic review will start when the model still can't analyze a change on the automatic retry
items.zh: \[Code Review] 改进 Code Review 的检查运行：当模型在自动重试时仍无法分析某项变更，会说明不会再启动进一步的自动审查

items.en: \[Code Review] Improved Code Review reliability: a review whose session fails to start because of a transient server fault is now retried once automatically, and its check run says so
items.zh: \[Code Review] 改进 Code Review 的可靠性：因临时服务器故障导致 session 无法启动的审查现在会自动重试一次，并在其检查运行中说明

items.en: Fixed long freezes at startup and after reading or editing files when a CLAUDE.md file holds a very long list item
items.zh: 修复当 CLAUDE.md 文件包含超长列表项时，启动时以及读取或编辑文件后出现长时间卡顿的问题

items.en: Fixed interrupting Claude not taking effect until a timeout while an MCP server had not answered a resource read or a skill was still downloading
items.zh: 修复当 MCP server 未响应资源读取或 skill 仍在下载时，中断 Claude 要等到超时才生效的问题

items.en: Fixed standard-context sessions stopping with "Usage credits required for 1M context" when a request ran over 200K tokens; Claude Code now compacts the conversation and continues
items.zh: 修复标准上下文 session 在请求超过 200K tokens 时以“Usage credits required for 1M context”停止的问题；Claude Code 现在会压缩对话并继续

items.en: Fixed Write and Edit stalling for up to 5 seconds after they ran, and reporting 0 lines changed, when changing thousands of lines in a file
items.zh: 修复在文件中修改数千行时，Write 和 Edit 执行后卡住最长 5 秒并报告更改 0 行的问题

items.en: Fixed subagents being unable to use MCP tools from servers that finish connecting after the subagent starts
items.zh: 修复了 subagent 无法使用 MCP 工具的问题：这些工具来自在 subagent 启动后才完成连接的服务器

items.en: Fixed Claude seeing stale MEMORY.md and CLAUDE.md content right after automatic compaction when those files were edited earlier in the session
items.zh: 修复了以下问题：若在 session 早期编辑过 MEMORY.md 和 CLAUDE.md，自动上下文压缩刚完成时 Claude 会看到这两个文件的陈旧内容

items.en: Fixed `claude -p` and SDK sessions saving transcript messages out of order or keeping messages that were taken back
items.zh: 修复了 `claude -p` 和 SDK session 保存转录消息时顺序错乱，或保留了已被撤回的消息的问题

items.en: Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks running about twice a minute for each running subagent instead of once when it finishes
items.zh: 修复了 `SubagentStop` hook 对每个运行中的 subagent 约每分钟触发两次、而非在完成时触发一次的问题

items.en: Fixed the @ file picker ignoring `.ignore`/`.rgignore` negation rules that re-include git-ignored files
items.zh: 修复了 @ 文件选择器忽略 `.ignore`/`.rgignore` 中重新包含被 git 忽略文件的否定规则的问题

items.en: Fixed a subagent's isolated worktree being removed while a background subagent it started was still working in it
items.zh: 修复了 subagent 的隔离 worktree 在其启动的后台 subagent 仍在该 worktree 中工作时就被删除的问题

items.en: Fixed background agents in auto mode that wait on their own shells starting a new main conversation turn on every wake
items.zh: 修复了自动模式下等待自身 shell 的后台 agent 每次唤醒都会开启新的主对话轮次的问题

items.en: Fixed the Bash tool description claiming the working directory always persists between calls
items.zh: 修复了 Bash 工具描述声称工作目录总会在调用之间保留的问题

items.en: Fixed the environment block naming a shell commands don't run in, such as fish when the Bash tool uses zsh
items.zh: 修复了环境信息块中列出的 shell 并非命令实际运行所用 shell 的问题，例如 Bash 工具使用 zsh 时却列出 fish

items.en: Fixed `claude mcp add`, `claude mcp remove` and `/mcp` naming the current folder instead of the project entry in `~/.claude.json` that holds a local-scope server when run below a repository root
items.zh: 修复了在仓库根目录以下运行时，`claude mcp add`、`claude mcp remove` 和 `/mcp` 显示当前文件夹、而非 `~/.claude.json` 中存放本地作用域服务器的项目条目的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` showing the error code twice on failed-connection lines (for example `ENOENT: ENOENT: …`)
items.zh: 修复了 `claude mcp list` 和 `claude mcp get` 在连接失败的行中重复显示错误代码的问题（例如 `ENOENT: ENOENT: …`）

items.en: Fixed Remote Control sessions staying on "Connecting" for about two minutes when a network proxy blocks a startup request
items.zh: 修复了网络代理阻止启动请求时，远程控制 session 停留在“Connecting”约两分钟的问题

items.en: Fixed messages that Claude sends to a cloud or Remote Control session appearing as your own message in the Claude mobile apps
items.zh: 修复了 Claude 发送到云端或远程控制 session 的消息在 Claude 移动端应用中显示为你自己的消息的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude not being told the cause when a file attached to a message sent over Remote Control or to a cloud session could not be saved because the disk was full, or that a message's attachments past the first 20 were left out
items.zh: 修复了以下问题：通过远程控制发送或发送到云端 session 的消息所附文件因磁盘已满而无法保存时，Claude 未被告知原因；消息中第 20 个之后的附件被遗漏时也未告知

items.en: Fixed WebFetch and WebSearch hanging on a stalled response in Cowork cloud sessions; an unfinished request now fails after 300 seconds
items.zh: 修复了 Cowork 云端 session 中 WebFetch 和 WebSearch 因响应停滞而挂起的问题；未完成的请求现在会在 300 秒后失败

items.en: Fixed a background session that crashed between turns not being restarted while it was attached, pinned, or had a scheduled task or wake-up set
items.zh: 修复了在轮次之间崩溃的后台 session 在处于附加、固定状态，或设置了计划任务或唤醒时未被重启的问题

items.en: Fixed the "background service did not respond" error suggesting the disabled `claude daemon restart`; it now suggests `claude daemon stop --any` and says it ends background sessions
items.zh: 修复了“background service did not respond”错误建议使用已禁用的 `claude daemon restart` 的问题；现在改为建议 `claude daemon stop --any`，并说明该命令会结束后台 session

items.en: Fixed `claude respawn <id>` starting the background service before reporting that no background session matches the id
items.zh: 修复了 `claude respawn <id>` 在报告没有后台 session 匹配该 id 之前就启动后台服务的问题

items.en: Fixed `/effort` not warning about a prompt cache miss in plan mode when the plan model differs from the session model
items.zh: 修复了 plan 模式中 plan 模型与 session 模型不同时，`/effort` 未提示 prompt 缓存未命中的问题

items.en: Fixed `/ide` saying the VS Code extension was installed before the install finished or when it failed
items.zh: 修复了 `/ide` 在安装完成前或安装失败时却提示 VS Code 扩展已安装的问题

items.en: Fixed the Write tool's file preview skipping rows and miscounting hidden lines when a line is wider than the terminal
items.zh: 修复了当某行宽度超过终端时，Write 工具的文件预览跳过行并错误统计隐藏行数的问题

items.en: Fixed ↑ in an agent's chat tab recalling a message that was still waiting to be delivered, so resending it sent a second copy
items.zh: 修复了在 agent 的聊天标签页中按 ↑ 会召回仍在等待投递的消息，导致重新发送时发出第二份副本的问题

items.en: Fixed Cowork cloud sessions losing their connectors and most tools after a restart when a plugin or your settings named an `agent`; Cowork cloud sessions now ignore that setting
items.zh: 修复了当 plugin 或你的设置指定了 `agent` 时，Cowork 云 session 在重启后丢失 connector 和大部分工具的问题；Cowork 云 session 现在会忽略该设置

items.en: Fixed agent teams sessions showing an empty task list when coming back with `--resume`, `--continue`, `/resume` or `--session-id`, including after `/clear` or a crash, and `/branch` writing to the original session's list
items.zh: 修复了 agent teams session 在通过 `--resume`、`--continue`、`/resume` 或 `--session-id` 返回时（包括在 `/clear` 或崩溃之后）显示空任务列表的问题，以及 `/branch` 写入原 session 任务列表的问题

items.en: Fixed pasting text that mentions an image file, such as `! open /tmp/shot.png` or `/review look at /tmp/shot.png`, attaching the image and dropping its path from the prompt
items.zh: 修复了粘贴提及图片文件的文本（例如 `! open /tmp/shot.png` 或 `/review look at /tmp/shot.png`）时会附加该图片并从 prompt 中删除其路径的问题

items.en: Fixed the feedback draft card showing its 1/2/0 and Esc shortcuts while the prompt has text, when those keys act on the prompt instead of the card
items.zh: 修复了反馈草稿卡片在 prompt 已有文本时仍显示其 1/2/0 和 Esc 快捷键的问题，此时这些按键实际作用于 prompt 而非卡片

items.en: Fixed a lone backslash in quotes or brackets, like `"\"` or `(\)`, disappearing from Claude's responses
items.zh: 修复了引号或括号中的单个反斜杠（例如 `"\"` 或 `(\)`）从 Claude 的回复中消失的问题

items.en: Fixed agent teammates compacting their history when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set
items.zh: 修复了设置 `DISABLE_COMPACT` 时 agent 队友仍会压缩其历史记录的问题

items.en: Fixed the rewind menu offering "Summarize from here" and "Summarize up to here" when `DISABLE_COMPACT` is set
items.zh: 修复了设置 `DISABLE_COMPACT` 时回退菜单仍提供“Summarize from here”和“Summarize up to here”的问题

items.en: Fixed a finished `/code-review`, or another skill that runs in a sub-agent, running a second time when a cloud or background session restarts
items.zh: 修复了已完成的 `/code-review` 或其他在 sub-agent 中运行的 skill 在云 session 或后台 session 重启时再次运行的问题

items.en: Fixed long hidden thinking being cut off as idle on Google Vertex AI, Microsoft Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS, where the endpoint sends thinking progress updates
items.zh: 修复了在 Google Vertex AI、Microsoft Foundry 和 Claude Platform on AWS 上，长时间隐藏思考因端点发送思考进度更新而被误判为空闲并截断的问题

items.en: Fixed `/ide` saying it had installed the JetBrains plugin when nothing was installed
items.zh: 修复了 `/ide` 在未安装任何内容时却声称已安装 JetBrains plugin 的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude Pro and Max subscribers being told to ask their admin when their subscription can't be used; the message now points to billing settings
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Pro 和 Max 订阅用户在订阅无法使用时被提示联系管理员的问题；现在该消息会指向账单设置

items.en: Fixed the diff pane opening by itself after an edit in wide fullscreen terminals when it had nothing to show
items.zh: 修复了在宽屏全屏终端中编辑后，diff 面板在无内容可显示时仍自动打开的问题

items.en: Fixed `/mcp` showing a remote server as failed after "Clear authentication" when the server works without sign-in
items.zh: 修复了在无需登录即可工作的远程服务器上执行“Clear authentication”后，`/mcp` 将其显示为失败的问题

items.en: Fixed `/mcp` showing "authenticated" for a remote server that Claude Code sends no credentials to
items.zh: 修复了 `/mcp` 对 Claude Code 未发送任何凭据的远程服务器显示“authenticated”的问题

items.en: Fixed a `--plugin-dir` folder of plugins loading as one plugin when an empty `.mcp.json` was at its top
items.zh: 修复了当 `--plugin-dir` 指定的 plugins 文件夹顶层存在空的 `.mcp.json` 时，该文件夹被加载为单个 plugin 的问题

items.en: Fixed `/usage` never showing large prompt-cache misses under "What's contributing to your limits usage?"
items.zh: 修复了 `/usage` 在“What's contributing to your limits usage?”下从不显示大量 prompt 缓存未命中的问题

items.en: Fixed status line links staying plain text in background sessions after you open them from a terminal that supports links
items.zh: 修复了从支持链接的终端打开后台 session 后，状态栏链接仍显示为纯文本的问题

items.en: Fixed the /rewind confirmation saying the conversation "will be forked" when the later messages are removed from the conversation
items.zh: 修复了 /rewind 确认提示在后续消息被从对话中移除时却称对话“will be forked”的问题

items.en: Fixed the /rewind warning that wrongly said manual and Bash edits are never affected by a code restore
items.zh: 修复了 /rewind 警告误报手动编辑和 Bash 编辑永远不会受代码恢复影响的问题

items.en: Fixed plan approval in screen reader mode sending feedback you had dismissed with Escape
items.zh: 修复了屏幕阅读器模式下计划审批会发送已用 Escape 关闭的反馈的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude Code retrying requests the API marked not to retry, which could hold a turn for minutes or, in unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`), indefinitely
items.zh: 修复了 Claude Code 对 API 标记为不可重试的请求仍进行重试的问题，该问题可能导致一轮对话卡住数分钟，在无人值守重试模式（`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`）下甚至会无限期卡住

items.en: Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when a `--plugin-dir` folder was also an added directory and `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` was on
items.zh: Linux：修复了当 `--plugin-dir` 文件夹同时是已添加的目录且启用了 `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` 时，沙箱化 Bash 命令因 `bwrap: Can't create file` 而失败的问题

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed a session failing to start when a rate limit (HTTP 429, or a git wrapper that exits 75) blocks an added read-only repository; it now starts without that repository
items.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了速率限制（HTTP 429，或 git 包装器以 75 退出）阻止某个已添加的只读仓库时 session 无法启动的问题；现在会在不包含该仓库的情况下启动

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed custom skills and custom slash commands sent from the VS Code or JetBrains panel leaving out the open file or selected lines that ordinary messages include (anthropics/claude-code#102799)
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了从 VS Code 或 JetBrains 面板发送的自定义 skills 和自定义斜杠命令遗漏普通消息所包含的打开文件或选中行的问题（anthropics/claude-code#102799）

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the extension host freezing while the login shell ran its start-up files to read PATH on macOS and Linux
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在 macOS 和 Linux 上登录 shell 运行启动文件以读取 PATH 时扩展宿主卡死的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed clicking an image in a tool result, or closing its preview, also opening the result's text in an editor tab
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了点击工具结果中的图片或关闭其预览时，也会在编辑器标签页中打开该结果文本的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed voice dictation continuing to record after a message was sent with the Send button; sending now stops dictation first, as pressing Enter already did
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了用发送按钮发送消息后语音听写仍在继续录制的问题；现在发送前会先停止听写，与按 Enter 的行为一致

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed routines in Anthropic-hosted environments staying locked after their owner left the organization and rejoined; the owner can now turn them back on
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了 Anthropic 托管环境中的例程在其所有者离开组织并重新加入后仍保持锁定的问题；所有者现在可以重新启用它们

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed a failed routine API token delete or regenerate showing nothing if the edit dialog had already closed; it now shows an error toast
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了例程 API token 删除或重新生成失败时，若编辑对话框已关闭则不显示任何提示的问题；现在会显示错误 toast

items.en: \[Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud environment dialogs, including the admin dialog, accepting duplicate names; they now refuse a name another listed environment already has
items.zh: \[Cloud sessions] 修复了云环境对话框（包括管理员对话框）接受重复名称的问题；现在会拒绝其他已列出环境已使用的名称

summary.tldr: 新增自托管运行器保持空闲、VSCode 代码着色，并修复大量卡顿与后台会话问题。

highlights.title: 自托管运行器可保持空闲
highlights.detail: 新增 --hold-idle-file 与 --max-hold-min，主机报告遗留进程时可让空闲 session 保持存活，避免被回收。

highlights.title: ultrathink 改为 xhigh 力度
highlights.detail: 在 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5、Haiku 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 上通过 Anthropic API 以 xhigh 力度运行该轮；工作中输入可提升剩余部分力度。

highlights.title: JSON 输出转义控制字符
highlights.detail: --output-format json 与 stream-json 将 DEL、C1 控制字符和 Unicode 格式字符写为 \uXXXX 转义，解析后的值不变。

highlights.title: 模型设置改从签名文件加载
highlights.detail: Bedrock、Mantle、Vertex 和 Foundry 上的 Claude Code 改为从 downloads.claude.ai 的签名文件加载模型设置，可用环境变量关闭。

highlights.title: 修复长上下文与编辑卡顿
highlights.detail: 修复超长 CLAUDE.md 列表项导致启动卡顿、大文件 Write/Edit 卡住 5 秒并报 0 行，以及超 200K tokens 时误报需 1M 上下文额度的问题。

highlights.title: 修复后台与 subagent 问题
highlights.detail: 修复 SubagentStop hook 重复触发、subagent 无法使用后连接 MCP 工具、隔离 worktree 过早删除，以及后台 session 崩溃后不重启等问题。
